spec.expr: label_set(sum by(month)(last_over_time(energyPriceBoughtDaily[$__range])),"series","purchased") or label_set(-(sum by(month)(last_over_time(energyPriceSoldDaily[$__range]))),"series","sold") or label_set(clamp_min((sum by(month)(last_over_time(energyPriceBoughtDaily[$__range])))-(sum by(month)(last_over_time(energyPriceSoldDaily[$__range]))),0),"series","costs") or label_set(clamp_max((sum by(month)(last_over_time(energyPriceBoughtDaily[$__range])))-(sum by(month)(last_over_time(energyPriceSoldDaily[$__range]))),0),"series","profit")

spec.title: PV payback
spec.description: Linear annualisation from days with positive home consumption. Partial years are seasonally biased. Payback is an estimate. No finite payback period is shown for non-positive annual savings.

spec.title: Battery payback
spec.description: Linear annualisation from days with positive home consumption. Partial years are seasonally biased. Payback is an estimate. No finite payback period is shown for non-positive annual savings.

spec.title: Driving costs — $vehicle
spec.description: Distance = maximum minus minimum daily odometer in the selected period. Session averages are time averages, not energy-weighted. Consumption includes charging losses; unrecorded charging is excluded.
